title: Build failure on LuaJIT with parallel build

labels.name: build
labels.description: building and installing Neovim using the provided scripts

labels.name: bug-regression
labels.description: wrong behavior that was introduced in a previous commit (please bisect)

body:

head

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

n/a

### Operating system/version

ubuntu 20.04 (via WSL)

### Terminal name/version

n/a

### $TERM environment variable

n/a

### Installation

n/a

### How to reproduce the issue

make CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/home/dch/.local/nvim -j8

### Expected behavior

compiles
